enlightenment: The hallucinatory drugs only reveal the world of images we contain but do not teach us interpretation, illumination, or enlightenment.
Elegance is a small price to pay for enlightenment, and I was glad to pay it.
enlisted: All you can be sure about in a political-minded writer is that if his work should last you will have to skip the politics when you read it. Many of the so-called politically enlisted writers change their politics frequently... Perhaps it can be respected as a form of the pursuit of happiness.
enlist: "garbageman: the man with the orderly mind"
enlarged: We live well in the houses—well enough. But we are ruled utterly by fear. There was a time we sailed in ships between the stars, and now we dare not go a hundred miles from home. We keep a little knowledge, and do nothing with it. But once we used that knowledge to weave the pattern of life like a tapestry across night and chaos. We enlarged the chances of life. We did man’s work.
